# 题迹 Questrace 2.1.0

## 中文说明

题迹 Questrace 2.1.0 在 2.0.0 的基础上补齐复习流程、更新提醒与外观自定义。桌面程序仍把网页界面和 Go 服务打包在一起，使用 SQLite 与本地文件保存数据；目标电脑不需要安装 MySQL、MinIO、Qdrant、Docker、Node.js 或 Go。自本版本起，产品、仓库与发行产物统一使用「题迹 Questrace」名称（旧称 Notebook）。

### 下载

- Windows x64 安装包：`Questrace-2.1.0-windows-x64-Setup.exe`（含安装向导、快捷方式和独立卸载程序）
- macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）和 Intel（x64）程序
- Linux amd64 和 arm64 压缩包
- Android APK
- 用于完整性校验的 `SHA256SUMS`

### 本版要点

- 复习：新增复习计划、自动组卷、自评、续练与历史；掌握状态随到期复习逐步变化，连续到期答对后标为已掌握。
- 外观：手机端新增松林绿、樱雾粉、落日橙、星夜靛、石墨灰五种配色与“自定义”外观，调色盘支持拖动选色并实时预览整套浅深界面；强调色改为跟随外观色。
- 更新提醒：Windows、macOS、Linux 与手机端都会检查 GitHub 正式版本，可关闭自动检查或手动检查。
- 检索与筛选：错题支持按标签多选筛选，标签管理可直达题目；公式搜索兼容空格与常见 LaTeX 排版差异。
- 稳定性：手机读取请求遇到短暂断线或超时最多重试一次（写操作不重放）；SQLite 增量升级前自动备份；背景图片上限提升至 10 MiB。

### 签名与校验

- Windows 安装包使用项目自签名证书签名，构建流程会校验证书与产物的指纹一致；该证书未通过公共 CA 信任，Windows 首次运行仍会提示“未知发布者”，请先核对 `SHA256SUMS` 中对应文件的校验值再允许运行。
- macOS 程序为 ad-hoc 签名，未经过 Apple 公证，首次启动需要手动允许。
- Android 包使用项目固定的 release 密钥签名。

### 升级前须知

- 从 2.0.0 覆盖安装即可升级：数据目录、数据库与账户保留，SQLite 会在升级前自动备份。
- 仍在使用 Notebook 1.x 的安装不会自动迁移，请保留原安装与数据。
- 默认数据目录、备份命令和源码构建方式见仓库 [README](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/README.md)。
- 仓库保留 iOS 源码及[编译说明](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/mobile/flutter_app/docs/IOS_SETUP.md)，本版仍不提供 IPA 或 TestFlight 包。

完整变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

---

## English

Questrace 2.1.0 builds on 2.0.0 with a review workflow, update notices and customisable appearance. The desktop application still bundles the web interface and Go service, stores data in SQLite and local files, and requires no MySQL, MinIO, Qdrant, Docker, Node.js or Go on the destination computer. Starting with this version the product, repository and release assets all use the 题迹 Questrace name (formerly Notebook).

### Downloads

- Windows x64 installer: `Questrace-2.1.0-windows-x64-Setup.exe`, with a setup wizard, shortcuts and an uninstaller
- macOS applications for Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x64)
- Linux archives for amd64 and arm64
- Android APK
- `SHA256SUMS` for integrity verification

### Highlights

- Review: a review planner with automatic sessions, self-assessment, continuing a session and history; mastery states follow due reviews and settle to mastered after consecutive correct reviews.
- Appearance: five more phone presets (pine, rose, amber, indigo, graphite) plus a custom appearance with a palette picker, drag selection and a live preview of the whole light and dark interface. The accent colour now follows the selected appearance.
- Update notices: Windows, macOS, Linux and the phone client all check official GitHub releases, with automatic checks that can be turned off and a manual check.
- Search and filtering: wrong questions can be filtered by multiple tags, tag management links straight to matching questions, and formula search tolerates spaces and common LaTeX differences.
- Stability: phone reads that hit a brief disconnect or timeout are retried once (writes are never replayed), SQLite backs up before an incremental upgrade, and the background image limit rises to 10 MiB.

### Signing and verification

- The Windows installer is signed with the project's self-signed certificate and the build verifies that the certificate thumbprint matches the artifact. The certificate is not trusted by a public CA, so Windows still reports an unknown publisher on first launch; verify the matching `SHA256SUMS` entry before allowing it to run.
- macOS applications use ad-hoc signing without Apple notarization and must be allowed manually on first launch.
- Android packages use the project's persistent release key.

### Before upgrading

- Installing 2.1.0 over 2.0.0 keeps the data directory, database and accounts; SQLite backs up before migrating.
- Installations still on Notebook 1.x are not migrated automatically; keep the original installation and data intact.
- The default data locations, backup commands and source-build instructions are documented in the repository [README](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/README.md).
- iOS source and [build instructions](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/mobile/flutter_app/docs/IOS_SETUP.md) are included, but this version still provides no IPA or TestFlight build.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full change summary.
